decision_conditions: Condition : 3 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 5 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 6 - Details of the security door at the High Street entrance and lighting for the proposed entrance points and stairwell shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The approved access to the High Street shall be used solely by the residents of the existing flats above No.14-16 Wilton Parade and details of how this shall be managed in practice, shall be submitted and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the development commences, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 8 - Details of the phasing of the approved development shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the commencement of operations.
Condition : 9 - Safe and secure access shall be maintained at all times to the retained flats above No.13 -16 Wilton Parade and to the ground floor properties at No.13-16 Wilton Parade.
description: The creation of a stairwell to provide a new means of access to High Street, Feltham, as well as an adaptation of the approved staircase to Site L to allow access to the rear service lane for occupants of the retained flats at 13a-16a Wilton Parade, as an amendment to planning permission granted on 5th April 2002 for the comprehensive redevelopment of parts of Feltham Town Centre including in particular the private residential, five storey building with ground floor restaurants, known as Site L.
